verdict.rationale: Deel's immigration pages say it provides the documentation and guidance needed to include spouses and children, and its glossary lists dependent visa application support. This confirms dependents are covered in general terms, but no specific dependent visa types are documented. missing for 10: explicit O-3/H-4 dependent visa coverage, spousal work authorization (e.g., EAD) support, detail on dependent filing process or pricing, independent/hands-on corroboration.
